createWorld.tab.cubicchunks.title: Cubic Chunks
selectWorld.cubicChunks.info: Stores the world in 32-block cubes, so it can be far taller and deeper than vanilla. Fixed once the world is made; players need Cubic Chunks to join it.
selectWorld.cubicChunks.range: Cubic worlds in this game can reach from Y %s to %s. The heightLimit setting in config/cubicchunks_common.toml decides this (restart to change it).
disconnect.cubicchunks.heightLimit: This server runs Cubic Chunks with heightLimit %s and this game runs it with %s. Set the same value in config/cubicchunks_common.toml and restart.
disconnect.cubicchunks.vanillaServer: This server doesn't run Cubic Chunks. With Cubic Chunks installed, this game reads block positions differently, so it can't play there.
